## Requirements: WebSocket Runtime V2 — isolated real-time stream dispatch and resource fences

### Scope and independent delivery
Parent #4431; main baseline e656d1f9c95baafc8735a2bb0274f668a2cc30d7. No historical Issue is reopened, reused or required for execution. Own Stream domain classification and provider semantics, terminal data path, stream-local admission/credit/fairness and resource fences. Can implement via existing Writer and Request interfaces, no hard dependency on new scheduler. Historical #1645/#1925/#2877/#1021 are regression contracts, not work packages. Preserve existing negotiated progress vs legacy applied operation and exact generation/epoch/frontier checks.
Design:
- Classify each real-time wire independently of Protocol Kernel category: reliable ordered input; recoverable sequenced output/logs when provider can replay; latest-state notifications with generation-aware coalescence. Terminal ACK/progress are stream flow control, not general RPC work; attach/authority/resize may carry dependencies, preserve their contracts. No universal replay database or blanket lossy queue.
- Separate per-stream finite frame/byte window and per-runtime budget from general RPC permits. Avoid blocking physical Reader on stream admission; reliable input must not silently disappear or be replayed blindly; overflow explicit refusal/connection recovery using existing sequence/ACK semantics. Output loss detected via gap and existing replay/checkpoint path, slow subscriber isolated. Latest state merges only within compatible incarnation/key, resync on overflow.
- Session owner coordinates cross-domain fence: kill/create, control lease transfer, sandbox/pane transition and resize ordering must reject or serialize stale input; do not introduce second Session owner. Resolve dependencies by resource fences not transport-wide waits.
- Relay remains forwarding adapter, never synthesizes frontier/authority; preserve input batching/order and negotiated capabilities. Existing Agent state outbox remains canonical for latest state; future Claude/Codex/build providers consume the same delivery contract without requiring implementation now.
- Public seam: stream admission/event result and class-aware send via existing adapter; stream owner handles subscription lifetime/credit/recovery; event hooks expose lag, gap, reconcile and coalesce (units explicit).

### Success Criteria
- [ ] SC-01 At the exact-head Rust Quality Gate (`rust-check` → `rust-test-unit`), the two-peer test `a_stalled_observer_does_not_delay_the_controller_input_ack` executes and passes: with the observer's Response class saturated, the controller's input-ACK fan-out completes inside the 500ms notification bound rather than parking for the stall grace. Together with the exact-head tests for independent finite stream admission, input order/ACK semantics, no silent overflow, latest-state coalescence without crossing incarnation/epoch, this proves slow-subscriber isolation with explicit recovery indication.
- [x] SC-02 Staging isolated terminal protocol/runtime Case exercises P2P and Relay under blocked ordinary request, independent terminal stream input/output, injected output gap, reconnect and replay/checkpoint; observed byte/ordinal sequence and parser progress follow existing contract, no duplicate input.
- [x] SC-03 Staging runtime Case gates kill/recreate, authority transfer and sandbox/pane or resize transition against queued input; stale epoch/generation cannot write to the replacement resource, and valid current input/resize retains required ordering.

SC → scenario: SC-01 SCN-06 (exact PR-head focused CI/Gate/test or document evidence; read-only Agent reviews authenticated result); SC-02 SCN-03 (isolated source-aligned staging Case; trusted run/attempt/SHA evidence); SC-03 SCN-03 (isolated source-aligned staging Case; trusted run/attempt/SHA evidence). For runtime Cases use approved full-stack-local protocol/runtime verifier with private tmux and bounded fault injection; for Knowledge publication use existing trusted publisher/readback receipt, never grant PR credentials. No blanket Full E2E or production probe.

## E2E Verification
### New
- none: targeted runtime/contract/document proof; no new browser interaction

- terminal-consistency-faults
